summary: No new role cleared every hard gate. Joko and Inato publish salary floors below the required minimum; OpenAI and Owkin do not publish a numerical France salary range. All four are exclusions or near-misses, not recommendations.
coverage: 39 official Ashby boards retrieved and screened from 50 attempted endpoints. Four additional individual listings and all four application forms rendered. Two Lever board endpoints also returned readable data, including Pigment for continuity. This bounded search is not an exhaustive market census; board screening is discovery, not verification of every opening.
criteria: Paris hybrid with explicit attendance, or fully remote explicitly allowing France-based applicants.
Senior/staff hands-on AI-central engineering; titles alone do not establish scope or level.
Employer-published annual gross cash-base lower bound strictly above €100,000, or at least €80,000 with explicit equity. Equity is not cash; packages, estimates and upper bounds do not pass.
No unchanged previously reported selections. Historical qualification and checked dates are preserved, not presented as today's live verification.
uncertainty: Evidence checked October 14, 2026. The four role publication dates are employer ATS dates, not newly posted October openings.

Eleven attempted Ashby board aliases returned 404; this does not establish that those employers have no vacancies. Search extraction was unavailable, so official ATS data and browser rendering supplied the listing evidence.

Joko and Inato publish annual Salary metadata with equity separately offered; a fixed gross cash-base label is not explicit. Their published numerical floors are already below €80,000. Joko additionally says final compensation may fall below its displayed range.
Owkin's listing explicitly permits remote work in France despite its Hybrid metadata. Its Scientist II title and five-year experience requirement do not explicitly establish senior/staff entry.
OpenAI's application confirms three office days per week. Senior/staff level and an engineering-primary rather than community/adoption-primary remit remain unverified.

No employer advanced to separate product and company diligence. Funding, current financial condition, employee size and recent material activity are not publicly verified in this run; listing marketing claims are not independent diligence.

Deduplication covers accessible October 10–13 reports and saved ATS snapshots, supplemented by recorded earlier continuity. It is not an exhaustive historic archive. Reachable application forms do not prove eligibility or hiring responsiveness.
decision: No approval needed for this authorized daily website update. No newly qualifying application is recommended. Any independent follow-up should first establish qualifying fixed annual cash-base terms and all remaining location, seniority and role-scope conditions. No applications or outreach were made.
